rationale: Moves EditorBridge's view attachments (attach_webview, detach_webview, attach_native_runtime, detach_native_runtime) out of the view-free core header into pulp/view/editor_bridge_attach.hpp as free functions, and render_claude_bridge_scaffold into pulp/view/editor_bridge_scaffold.hpp; both stay defined in pulp-view-tooling with the same bodies. The import-design CLI and the scaffold it emits only follow the new include and call spelling. No design-import, Chromium, rendering, or packaging authority moves.
